comment: Naming wire-format conformance fixture. The registrar (Rust, AgentNaming/pan-registrar) and the adapter/SDK (JS, mesh-adapter/) MUST both reproduce these exact bytes; a drift on either side breaks pairing, check-in, or card verification silently. Tests: the registrar repository's src/registrar.rs (mod naming_conformance, against its exported copy of this file) and mesh-adapter/test/conformance.mjs. The Rust half named a tests/conformance.rs that never existed until 2026-08-10, so for its whole life this fixture pinned only the JavaScript READER while the registrar that MINTS AND SIGNS cards was held to nothing; it lives inside registrar.rs because the crate has no library target for an integration test to import.
